overview: 112 official Qs (2008, 2012, 2017, 2019, 2025). The 'STI Policy' leaf (61 Qs) is in practice general science: units, chemical names, alloys, body facts, CSIR lab locations. Then ICT terms and acronyms (14), e-governance (7, mostly AP platforms), emerging tech (7), space (9), and thin nuclear, defence and cyber. Almost all one-liners; 2019 Mains often gives stem + key only; 2019/2025 add matching and one A-R.

possibility.angle: General science in the 'STI Policy' leaf: units, chemical names, alloys, principles, biology basics, CSIR/DBT labs
possibility.what_they_ask: Chemical/common name (baking soda, water glass), alloy make-up, SI unit, working principle (centrifugation, RO, TIR), first discoverer, lab city, DBT vs CSIR institute

possibility.angle: National strategies and missions (Startup India etc.)
possibility.what_they_ask: Purpose of a named initiative (Startup India Yatra = tier-2/3 talent search)

possibility.angle: Emerging technology frontiers (nano, AI/IoT/AR, metamaterials, LIGO-India, genomics)
possibility.what_they_ask: Size range, coiner/pioneer of a term, institution behind an innovation, consortium acronym, facility city
Launch site/vehicle of a satellite, satellite power source, Bhuvan geo-tagging, which is not a student satellite
Location of NARL, Radio Astronomy Centre; moon 'firsts'

possibility.evidence: 2 Qs: 2008, 2025 (both BrahMos partner); structure and IGMDP not yet asked
possibility.what_they_ask: Partner country of a joint missile; natural targets: IGMDP (1983) missile list, DRDO founding (1958), missile types and ranges

possibility.angle: ICT and national IT policy: terms, acronyms, inventors, media vocabulary
possibility.what_they_ask: Full form (MPEG, DIMM, LED), bit/byte, WWW inventor, optical fibre principle, media terms (podcast, infomercial, semiotics)
What Bharat QR / BHIM is built on, India's first digital village
Name of the network/platform for a function (APSWAN, Jnanabhumi, Prajavani, Rajiv Internet Village), UIDAI ministry, user of D-Krishi

possibility.angle: Cyber security and National Cyber Security Policy
possibility.evidence: 3 Qs: 2019, 2025 (ransomware, digital arrest); NCSP not yet asked
possibility.what_they_ask: Type of malware named, meaning of a scam term; natural targets for NCSP 2013: year, nodal agency CERT-In

possibility.angle: Nuclear reactors, power plants, programme, radioisotopes
possibility.what_they_ask: Installed capacity on a date, fission vs fusion, largest research reactor, AHWR fuel, why 11 May is Technology Day, radioactivity seat (nucleus)

traps.trap: Same quantity on another scale [K vs C vs F]
traps.spot: Options carry the right event's value in other units or the neighbouring event (freezing)
traps.fix: Water boils 100 C = 373 K = 212 F; freezes 0 C = 273 K

traps.trap: Look-alike material from the same family
traps.spot: All options are oxides, silicates, polymers or copper alloys
traps.fix: Tape = iron oxide; water glass = sodium silicate; non-stick = PTFE; brass = Cu+Zn (bronze Cu+Sn)
traps.pyq: 'Silver iodide' for tape → ferric oxide (AgI = cloud seeding) [group2-2012-paper1#139]; brass → Copper and Zinc [group2-2012-paper1#93]

traps.trap: Related object offered instead of the one asked
traps.spot: Option is the vehicle/organ/container linked to the answer
traps.fix: Ask what exactly the stem names: satellite vs shuttle, carrier vessel vs pump
traps.pyq: 'Challenger' → Solar Max (Challenger was the shuttle) [group2-2008-paper1#1]; 'right ventricle' → pulmonary arteries [group2-2008-paper1#33]

traps.spot: Pair like osmosis/reverse osmosis, fission/fusion, low/high melting point
traps.fix: Desalination = reverse osmosis; splitting = fission; fuse = low melting point
traps.pyq: 'breaking apart ... called fusion' is the wrong statement → fission [mains-2019-paper1#90]; 'Osmosis' → Reverse osmosis [group2-2012-paper1#140]

traps.trap: Acronym letter swapped for a plausible word
traps.spot: Four options differ by one expanded word
traps.fix: MPEG E = Experts (like JPEG); DIMM D = Dual; LED D = Diode
traps.pyq: 'Moving Picture Electronic Group' → Experts [prelims-2019#13]; 'Digital In-line' → Dual [prelims-2019#17]

traps.trap: Look-alike Indian labs and their parent body
traps.spot: Biology-sounding name offered as DBT institute; lab city swapped
traps.fix: CCMB is CSIR despite 'biology'; CDRI Lucknow; CLRI Chennai
traps.pyq: 'Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology' → CSIR, DBT answer is CIAB [mains-2025-paper2#128]; CDRI → Lucknow [group2-2008-paper1#18]

traps.fix: BrahMos = India-Russia (Brahmaputra + Moskva); INSAT-4B = Ariane-5 from Kourou, French Guiana

traps.trap: Vehicle configuration of the sister rocket
traps.spot: Stage list matches PSLV when GSLV is asked
traps.fix: PSLV = solid-liquid-solid-liquid; GSLV = solid core + liquid (Vikas) + cryogenic
traps.pyq: 'First and third stage solid...' is PSLV → GSLV is solid, earth-storable liquid, cryogenic [mains-2025-paper2#117]

traps.trap: Near-identical platform names in AP e-governance
traps.spot: Praja-/AP-S... options differing by a syllable
traps.fix: APSWAN links Secretariat-district-mandal; Prajavani = grievances; Jnanabhumi = scholarships
Akodara (Gujarat) = first digital village; Dhasai (Thane) = first cashless

techniques.name: Family-member elimination [name the family first]
techniques.how: Identify the family all options share (oxides, alloys, silicates, units). Recall what each other member is famous for; the leftover fits.
techniques.example: Inductance: farad = capacitance, ohm = resistance, candela = luminous intensity → henry [prelims-2019#11]

techniques.name: Name-clue decoding
techniques.how: Many answers sit inside the name: BrahMos (Brahmaputra-Moskva), aqua regia ('royal water' dissolves the royal metal), IndIGO (Indian Initiative in Gravitational-wave Observations).
techniques.example: 'royal water' that reduced gold's weight → aqua regia; aqua fortis alone cannot dissolve gold [mains-2017-paper1#38]

techniques.name: Mechanism reasoning
techniques.how: Derive the answer from the physical/chemical mechanism rather than memory; reject options that describe a side effect.
techniques.example: Bird on a single wire: both feet at same potential, no current → 'no potential difference between its legs' [mains-2017-paper1#33]

techniques.name: Anchor-pair matching
techniques.how: In matching, fix the least-confusable pair first and strike all codes without it.
techniques.example: Braun = cathode ray tube (d-II) and Galileo = telescope (a-III) leave only a-III, b-IV, c-I, d-II [prelims-2019#18]

techniques.name: Stem-noun check
techniques.how: Underline the exact noun asked (satellite, organ, nutrient) and drop options that are a related but different category.
techniques.example: 'most important for growth' asks a nutrient: 'Milk' is a food, fats/vitamins give energy/protection → proteins [group2-2008-paper1#28]

techniques.name: Date-to-event anchor
techniques.how: For 'why this day' or 'first' questions, recall the anchor date and its event; other events happened on other dates.
techniques.example: 11 May = Pokhran-II 1998 → nuclear tests; PSLV/PARAM/first reactor are other dates [prelims-2017#135]

confusions.remember: Rayon = artificial silk from cellulose; nylon = first fully synthetic fibre
Artery takes venous blood to lungs; vein brings oxygenated blood back
Teratogen = birth defect; mutagen = DNA change
Fission splits heavy nuclei (reactors); fusion joins light nuclei (Sun)
Fuse = low melting point; filament = tungsten, high m.p.; heater = nichrome
PSLV S-L-S-L four stages; GSLV S-L-Cryo three stages
Both Hyderabad; CCMB is CSIR, CDFD is DBT
NARL near Tirupati (DOS); RAC Ooty (TIFR); GMRT near Pune
Akodara first digital village; Dhasai first cashless
eSeva urban (2001); RIV took services to rural areas
Dhruva = largest research reactor; Apsara = India's first (1956)
Luna 2 first to impact Moon (1959); Luna 9 first soft landing (1966)

anchors: Blood pH ≈ 7.4; tooth decay below pH 5.5
Wöhler 1828: urea, first synthetic organic compound
Herschel 1800: infra-red; Becquerel 1896: radioactivity (a nuclear property)
Vitamin B12 = cobalt; chlorophyll = magnesium; haemoglobin = iron
Tim Berners-Lee, CERN 1989: World Wide Web
BHIM (Dec 2016) runs on UPI; Bharat QR (2017) = interoperable payment QR
UIDAI: statutory under Aadhaar Act 2016, under MeitY
IGMDP 1983: Prithvi, Agni, Trishul, Akash, Nag
checklist: What family do all four options belong to? Recall each member's own claim to fame
Is the stem asking the object, its carrier, or its process?
Check units and scale (K/C/F, bits/bytes) before picking a number
Decode names and acronyms letter by letter
Is the process reversed (osmosis/RO, fission/fusion, artery/vein)?
Lab or platform question: confirm both city and parent body (CSIR/DBT/DOS, state/national)
Time-stamped figures (capacity, counts): answer for the year in the stem
